title: Hypothetical Change-Review Cards
selected_text: A hypothetical change-review card proposes a candidate guideline after an example change. A reviewer may accept, revise or reject the draft. Café notes remain provisional.
selection_reason: Synthetic prior-draft selection for a controlled test. Selection and usefulness are unverified.

sources.excerpt: A hypothetical change-review card proposes a candidate guideline after an example change. A reviewer may accept, revise or reject the draft. Café notes remain provisional.
Read an example change. Draft a candidate guideline. Place the draft in a pending-review queue; no rule is activated by this fictional exercise.
